rule: Every gate at the candidate is listed with its Q-IDs, every CI entrypoint and the check it runs is listed, and every deletion, count decrease, skip increase, missing test name and workflow change since each base is guarded by a selector into the candidate's own files, preserved as original bytes outside the public tree (recorded as preservation, not as protection), retired with an in-tree basis and the retiring commits, or reclassified with an in-tree basis. Mixed findings are split into components whose per-commit deltas check-map recomputes from history.

dispositions.guarded: (a) the candidate's own file or entrypoint carries the protection; selectors are verified at the candidate
dispositions.preserved: (b) only an internal record was affected; its original bytes are pinned in git history and kept in the local preservation root; not counted as protection
dispositions.retired: (c) the responsibility ended; basis lines at the candidate and the retiring commits (which must touch the file) are recorded
dispositions.reclassified: the finding is not a weakening; basis lines at the candidate are recorded
